arStrings.szText: Have you ever seen a storm just stop like that?
Two Amazons sit together looking out at the sea. Amazon_02 has a minor wound and Amazon_03 is treating her. Together, they reflect on the terrible, supernatural storm they just witnessed.
I've never seen a storm like that in my life. Raining like the end of the whole damned world...
